replies.author: Consistent_Reveal_53
replies.body:
would you want the non AI lies? Or With AI truth?  
if you would like me to lie then I'd say I drew it all by hand, scanned it, edited the assets, then implemented,  
if you would like me to tell the truth then I prototyped new SVG visual styles with Claude settling on a new style and then implementing it to the game.  
technically I only used AI for coding like Triple A studios do, but with my direction the visuals are made with math through code, so the visuals are both not made by AI and were made by AI,  
makes sense?  
I said all this for those who hate AI art and want monopoly so art stays expensive, but no one would be able to tell the entire thing is AI, in a couple of years no one will care.  
hope this helps.

replies.author: BillBangkok
replies.body: I don't mind it was made by ai, as long as you polished it. And your game look polished enough. Thank for the tips of using svg.
